# giraffegotchi

Source: https://github.com/elliotboney/giraffegotchi

Revision: `440a9545f5447c32cf48b8cb93f6258fbd842d13`

pet.h and pet.cpp are the unmodified hardware-free upstream care model. Giraffe poses in ../../games/GiraffeSprites.h are RGB565/alpha conversions of upstream img/giraffe PNGs. The original artwork and code are MIT licensed.
